transcript.text:
SailPoint ISC uses the OAuth 2.0 **client credentials** grant. Send a `POST` to your tenant's token endpoint:

```
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/oauth/token
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
```

**Request body (form-encoded):**
```
grant_type=client_credentials&client_id={your_client_id}&client_secret={your_client_secret}
```

---

**curl example:**
```bash
curl -s -X POST \
  "https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/oauth/token" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \
  -d "grant_type=client_credentials" \
  -d "client_id=${CLIENT_ID}" \
  -d "client_secret=${CLIENT_SECRET}"
```

**Python (requests) example:**
```python
import requests

tenant = "your-org"
resp = requests.post(
    f"https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/oauth/token",
    data={
        "grant_type": "client_credentials",
        "client_id": CLIENT_ID,
        "client_secret": CLIENT_SECRET,
    },
)
resp.raise_for_status()
access_token = resp.json()["access_token"]
```

**Successful response (200):**
```json
{
  "access_token": "eyJhbGciOi...",
  "token_type": "Bearer",
  "expires_in": 750
}
```

Use the token in subsequent API calls:
```
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
```

Personal Access Tokens inherit the scopes granted when they were created in the ISC UI — no additional scope parameter is needed in this request.

```answer-summary
    path: /oauth/token
    api_version: oauth
auth_flow: OAuth2 client credentials
required_scopes: []

```
